doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Chubby Jackson getting him into Barnet and Woody Herman
summary: Chubby Jackson recommended him to Charlie Barnet and Woody Herman; after the Army Herbie Fields.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: No. Just for Basic Training. MR. Was Chubby Jackson on the Woody Herman band when you were there?

Yeah, he’s the one that got me on because when I had the group with Shorty Rogers he was teaching the bass player. So Chubby got me on Woody’s band. Well first he got me on Barnet’s band. That was a great band at that point. And then he said the change is © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

coming and you’ve got to come in Woody’s band. So I went in Woody’s band and that’s where I got drafted. So that was that. Then the Army. And then when I got out of the Army I went with Herbie Fields for a little bit. He was working around. I don’t know if you know Herbie.
